headline: Australian Federal Government Extends Ban on KPMG Government Work
summary: The Australian federal government extended its ban on KPMG bidding for new government contracts until at least the end of February following ethical failings involving client data misuse.
why: Government contracting restrictions on major auditing and consulting firms affect professional services revenue streams and corporate governance standing.

impacts.name: KPMG
impacts.why: Exclusion from lucrative public sector advisory contracts limits growth avenues for the professional services firm.
